caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair positioned at a slight angle, with detailed rendering in shades of pencil or charcoal on a light, beige background. The chair has a high, rectangular backrest with ornate carvings at the top, including a fan-shaped motif in the center and circular decorative elements on either side. Below the top rail, the backrest features a panel with additional carved patterns, including geometric and possibly floral designs, framed by straight vertical rails. The seat of the chair is flat and appears to be solid wood, bordered by a beveled frame. The armrests are thick, flat, and supported at the front by turned posts, matching the form of the two front legs, which are also intricately turned. The two front legs are connected by a horizontal stretcher with a twisted or spiral design, mirrored by the stretcher on each side and at the front base, forming a sturdy support structure. The rear legs are straighter and simpler, blending into the backrest frame. The entire drawing is monochromatic, rendered with gradations of gray to depict depth, texture, and shadow, and occupies the central area of the paper, leaving ample blank space around the chair.
title: Carved Chair
